<description>
From the discussion in #36403, it is clear that there needs to be a way for users to rebroadcast a transaction. Currently, the way to do so requires getting the raw transaction, getting the hex, and using `sendrawtransaction`. This PR adds `rebroadcastwallettx` RPC that takes a txid to attempt to rebroadcast that single transaction. An action is also added to the GUI menu for each transaction to do the same.
</description>

[2026-11-11] rc:4538108571 inline on src/wallet/interfaces.cpp by vasild (member) (edited 2026-11-11):
Indeed. Redundant/unnecessary locking is confusing and makes it somewhat more difficult to assess the code. It will have to be removed if/when some day we try to change `cs_wallet` from `RecursiveMutex` to `Mutex`.

I checked that just removing this `LOCK(m_wallet->cs_wallet);` line compiles without any clang warnings. Further, adding this in `src/wallet/wallet.h`:

```diff
-    util::Expected<void, WalletError> RebroadcastSingleTransaction(const Txid& txid);
+    util::Expected<void, WalletError> RebroadcastSingleTransaction(const Txid& txid) EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(!cs_wallet);
```
would be even better :)
